titleEn: The Glory of Kings — The Bridle and the Chariot, the Return of Zion, and the Chastisement of Israel (ch. 113–115)
part: ch. 113–115 — the bridle and the chariot, the return of Zion, and the chastisement of Israel
about: Gregory the Wonder-worker, asked by the chief bishops how long Rome's curb for the enemy (the bridle made from the nails) and Ethiopia's chariot (Zion) will remain, foretells that a Roman king will pervert the faith, lose the bridle in the sea, and that Ethiopia will keep the right faith to the end (ch. 113). Zion will come at the last day, the dead will rise, and Enoch, Elijah, Moses and Aaron will open the Ark and shame the Jews with the tablets, the manna and Aaron's rod (ch. 114). Christ and the twelve apostles reproach Israel, the faithful are spared, and the sinners are judged by measure (ch. 115). Dillmann was not open for this draft; uncertain readings are marked (?). Source slips are kept as printed and noted: ጳጵሳት, ውስ ተ, ባውስተ, ሃሬኔዎስ/መርቅያኖስ, ቦዘያሜክርዎ, ፼ ዓመት.

sentences.t: ፻፲፫ ፡ በእንተ ፡ ሰረገላ ፡ ወመግረሬ ፡ ፀር ።
sentences.l: 113. Concerning chariot and-restrainer-of enemy.
sentences.i: Chapter 113: Concerning the chariot and the curb for the enemy
sentences.n: Chapter heading. ፻፲፫ is 113. በእንተ 'concerning' governs ሰረገላ 'chariot' and ወመግረሬ 'and the restrainer of' (?), with ፀር 'enemy' in the genitive. መግረሬ is not in my reading a word I can place from Dillmann (unavailable); the chapter itself shows it is the bit made from the nails of the cross, so 'curb, bit' (?) for the enemy. The chariot is Zion, on which the Ethiopian king 'runs' (unit 14).

sentences.t: አውሥኡ ፡ ወይቤልዎ ፡ ሊቃነ ፡ ጳጳሳት ፡ ለጎርጎርዮስ ፡ ገባሬ ፡ መንክር ፡ ናሁኬ ፡ ጠየቅነ ፡ ወአለበውከነ ፡ ከመ ፡ ከብሩ ፡ ወዐብዩ ፡ ነገሥተ ፡ ኢትዮጵያ ፡ በእንተ ፡ ጽዮን ፤
sentences.l: They-answered and-they-said-to-him chiefs-of bishops to-Gregory, worker-of wonder: Behold we-asked and-you-gave-understanding-us that honoured and-great kings-of Ethiopia on-account-of Zion;
sentences.i: The chief bishops answered and said to Gregory, the worker of wonders, 'Behold, we have asked, and you have given us to understand that the kings of Ethiopia are honoured and great on account of Zion;
sentences.n: Speakers: ሊቃነ ጳጳሳት 'chiefs of bishops' (construct plural), the bishops gathered in council, who address Gregory (ጎርጎርዮስ), here called ገባሬ መንክር 'worker of wonder', the Wonder-worker. The verbs: አውሥኡ 'they answered' (causative of ወሥአ); ወይቤልዎ 'and they said to him' (ብህለ + -ልዎ); ጠየቅነ 'we asked' (ጠየቀ, 1st plural perfect); ወአለበውከነ አለበወ 'give understanding' (causative of ለበወ) + -ከ 'you' + -ነ 'us'. ከብሩ and ዐብዩ are perfect 3rd plural of ከበረ 'be honoured' and ዐበየ 'be great', with the subject ነገሥተ 'kings' after the verbs. The ከመ clause gives what they have learned. Zion (the Ark) is the ground of Ethiopia's greatness.

sentences.t: ወካዕበ ፡ ዐብዩ ፡ ነገሥተ ፡ ሮም ፡ በእንተ ፡ ቅንዋት ፡ ዘገብረት ፡ ልጓመ ፡ እሌኒ ፡ ወኮኖ ፡ መግረሬ ፡ ፀር ፡ ለንጉሠ ፡ ሮም ፡ ወለንጉሠ ፡ ኢትዮጵያ ፡ ኮኖ ፡ ሰረገላ ፡ ወውእቱኒ ፡ ሞአ ፡ ፀሮ ፤
sentences.l: and-again great kings-of Rome on-account-of nails which Helena-made bridle, and-it-became-to-him restrainer-of enemy to-king-of Rome, and-to-king-of Ethiopia it-became-to-him chariot, and-he-also overcame his-enemy;
sentences.i: and again, that the kings of Rome are great on account of the nails from which Helena made a bridle; and it became for the king of Rome a curb for the enemy, and for the king of Ethiopia it became a chariot, and he too overcame his enemy;
sentences.n: The Roman side: ቅንዋት 'nails' (the nails of the cross; house rendering), from which ዘገብረት 'which she made' (ዘ- + perfect 3rd feminine, the subject Helena, እሌኒ, mother of Constantine, who in tradition found the cross) a ልጓም 'bridle' (ልጓመ is accusative). ኮኖ 'it became to him' (ኮነ + -ኦ) is anticipatory: the -ኦ is picked up by ለንጉሠ ሮም and again by ለንጉሠ ኢትዮጵያ. So the same pair of objects serves both kings: the nails/bridle for Rome, Zion as chariot for Ethiopia. ወውእቱኒ ሞአ ፀሮ 'and he too overcame his enemy': ሞአ 'overcame' (G perfect); 'he' is most naturally the Ethiopian king, the last named (?).

sentences.t: ወካዕበ ፡ ንግረነ ፡ እስከ ፡ ማእዜኑ ፡ ይነብር ፡ መግረሬ ፡ ፀር ፡ ኀበ ፡ ንጉሠ ፡ ሮም ፡ ወሰረገላ ፡ ምስለ ፡ ጽዮን ፡ ኀበ ፡ ንጉሠ ፡ ኢትዮጵያ ፤
sentences.l: and-again tell-us until when-? shall-remain restrainer-of enemy with king-of Rome, and-chariot with Zion with king-of Ethiopia;
sentences.i: And again, tell us, how long will the curb for the enemy remain with the king of Rome, and the chariot, Zion, with the king of Ethiopia;
sentences.n: The bishops' second question. እስከ ማእዜኑ 'until when?': ማእዜ 'when' + interrogative -ኑ. ይነብር 'will remain' is singular though two things are named: the verb agrees with the first, መግረሬ. ምስለ ጽዮን 'with Zion' is read as standing in apposition to ሰረገላ: the chariot is Zion. ኀበ 'with, in the possession of'.

sentences.t: ንግረነ ፡ እስመ ፡ ከሠተ ፡ ለከ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ ዘኮነ ፡ ወዘይከውን ፡ ራእየ ፡ ወትንቢተ ፡ ከመ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ ወኤልያስ ።
sentences.l: Tell-us, for he-revealed to-you God what-was and-what-will-be, vision and-prophecy, like Moses and-Elijah.
sentences.i: Tell us, for God has revealed to you what was and what will be, in vision and in prophecy, as to Moses and Elijah.'
sentences.n: ከሠተ 'revealed' (G perfect), with ለከ 'to you'; ዘኮነ ወዘይከውን 'that which was and that which will be', the two ዘ- clauses both the object. ራእየ ወትንቢተ are accusatives of manner, 'as vision and prophecy'. Moses and Elijah are the two who spoke with God and were seen with Christ on the mountain (Matthew 17:3); they stand for the prophet who is shown things. The bishops' speech ends at the ።.

sentences.t: አውሥአ ፡ ወይቤሎሙ ፡ አነ ፡ እከሥት ፡ ለክሙ ፡ ለንጉሠ ፡ ሮም ፡ ሶበ ፡ ተዐደወ ፡ ወአምዐዖ ፡ ለእግዚኣብሔር ፡ ባውስተ ፡ ሃይማኖት ፡ ዛቲ ፡ እንተ ፡ ሠራዕነ ፡ ሃይማኖተ ፡ ሀሎ ፡ ይትዐደዋ ፡ ዘይመጽእ ፡ ንጉሥ ፡ በሮሜ ፡ ወየኀብር ፡ ምስሌሁ ፡ ፩ ፡ ሊቀ ፡ ጳጵሳት ፡ ወይዌልጥዋ ፡ ወይገፈትእዋ ፡ ለነገረ ፡ ፲ወ፪ ፡ ሐዋርያት ፡ ወያፈልስዎ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ፍትወተ ፡ ልቦሙ ፡ ወይሜህሩ ፡ በፈቃዶሙ ፡ ወይመይጥዎ ፡ ለመጽሐፍ ፡ ውስ ፡ ተ ፡ ግዕዞሙ ፤
sentences.l: He-answered and-he-said-to-them: I I-will-reveal to-you concerning-king-of Rome when he-transgressed and-he-provoked-him God in-this faith which we-ordained as-faith; there-is he-will-transgress-her who-comes king in-Rome, and-will-join with-him one chief-of bishops, and-they-will-change-her and-they-will-thrust-aside the-word-of 12 apostles, and-they-will-move-him into desire-of heart-their and-they-will-teach by-will-their and-they-will-turn-him the-book into(?) freedom-their;
sentences.i: He answered and said to them, 'I will explain to you about the king of Rome: when he transgressed and provoked God within this faith that we ordained as the faith, there is one coming who will transgress it, a king in Rome; and one chief bishop will join with him, and they will change it and thrust aside the word of the twelve apostles, and will carry it off into the desire of their hearts, and will teach by their own will, and will turn the Book to their own freedom (?);
sentences.n: Gregory replies. The perfects after ሶበ (ተዐደወ, ወአምዐዖ) have a future or prophetic sense, 'when he shall have transgressed'; I give them as a plain past-in-prophecy. ተዐደወ 'transgressed' (ዐደወ 'pass over'), ወአምዐዖ 'provoked him' (causative of ምዕ 'be angry' (?) + -ኦ, doubled by ለእግዚኣብሔር). ባውስተ is printed so; read as በውስተ 'within, in' (?), a spelling slip. ሀሎ + imperfect (ይትዐደዋ) = 'is to', 'is about to': the 'faith' is feminine, hence -ዋ 'it/her' on ይትዐደዋ, ይዌልጥዋ, ይገፈትእዋ. ዘይመጽእ ንጉሥ 'a king who comes', not named here. ጳጵሳት is printed for ጳጳሳት, a source slip, kept. ይዌልጥዋ 'they will change' (ወለጠ), ይገፈትእዋ 'thrust aside' (ገፍትአ 'push, thrust'). ለነገረ marks the object: 'the word of the twelve apostles'. ወያፈልስዎ 'and they will move it' (causative of ፈለሰ 'migrate'), ውስተ ፍትወተ ልቦሙ 'into the desire of their hearts'. The last clause has a source slip: ውስ ፡ ተ is printed as two words; it must be ውስተ 'into'. ግዕዞሙ is ግዕዝ 'freedom, liberty' (the word that names the Geʿez language) + -ሙ 'their', so 'to their own freedom' (?), i.e. as they please; I cannot be sure of the sense without Dillmann (?). The unit has 43 words and no ፤ to cut at, so it is kept whole.

sentences.t: በከመ ፡ ይቤ ፡ ሐዋርያ ፡ በዘ ፡ ለሊሆሙ ፡ አትከሉ ፡ ርእሶሙ ፡ ከመ ፡ ሰዶም ፡ ወገሞራ ፤
sentences.l: As he-said apostle: in-that they-themselves they-planted heads-their like Sodom and-Gomorrah;
sentences.i: As the apostle said, because they themselves have set up their own heads like Sodom and Gomorrah (?);
sentences.n: An apostle is cited without a name; Sodom and Gomorrah are the standing example in 2 Peter 2:6 and Jude 7, but the words here are not a quotation I can match to either, so the saying is given as printed. አትከሉ 'they planted, set up' (ተከለ 'plant, fix'; the causative-looking አ- is as printed) with ርእሶሙ 'their heads' as object: 'set up their own heads' = made themselves the head (?). በዘ ለሊሆሙ 'in that they themselves' (ለሊሆሙ is the emphatic 'themselves'). The sense of the comparison is uncertain (?).

sentences.t: ወእግዚእነሂ ፡ ይቤሎሙ ፡ በወንጌል ፡ ለአርዳኢሁ ፡ ተዐቅቡ ፡ እምእለ ፡ ይመጽኡ ፡ ኀቤክሙ ፡ በአልባሰ ፡ አባግዕ ፡ ወእንተ ፡ ውስጦሙሰ ፡ ተኵላት ፡ ወመሠጥ ።
sentences.l: And-Lord-our-also he-said-to-them in-gospel to-disciples-his: Guard-yourselves from those-who they-come to-you in-garments-of sheep, and-those within-them-as-for wolves and-ravening(?).
sentences.i: And our Lord also said to them in the Gospel, to his disciples, 'Beware of those who come to you in the clothing of sheep, while within they are wolves and ravening (?).'
sentences.n: Matthew 7:15, 'wolves in sheep's clothing', put as a saying to the disciples. ተዐቅቡ 'guard yourselves' (imperative of ተዐቀበ), እምእለ 'from those who'. በአልባሰ አባግዕ 'in garments of sheep' (construct of plural አልባስ; አባግዕ plural of በግዕ). ወእንተ ውስጦሙሰ is odd: እንተ is the feminine relative and would not agree with 'wolves'; I take it as 'and what is within them' = 'while within them', as in the Gospel (?). ተኵላት 'wolves'. ወመሠጥ is read as 'and ravening (?)', ማሠጠ 'tear, snatch', echoing 'ravening wolves'; unsure without Dillmann (?).

sentences.t: ወሶበ ፡ አዕለውዋ ፡ ለሃይማኖት ፡ ትትሀየድ ፡ እምኔሆሙ ፡ መግረሬ ፡ ፀር ፡ ወመንበረ ፡ ጴጥሮስኒ ፡ አልቦ ፡ ዘይነብር ፡ ዲቤሃ ፡ እለ ፡ ወለጡ ፡ ሃይማኖትነ ፤
sentences.l: And-when they-perverted the-faith, it-will-be-removed from-them restrainer-of enemy, and-throne-of Peter-also there-is-not who sits upon-her, those-who they-changed faith-our;
sentences.i: And when they have perverted the faith, the curb for the enemy will be taken away from them, and the throne of Peter too will have none to sit upon it among those who changed our faith;
sentences.n: The consequence. አዕለውዋ 'they perverted her' (causative of ዐለወ, 'twist, pervert'; -ዋ is the faith); ትትሀየድ is the tä- passive of ሀየደ 'remove, take away', the subject መግረሬ ፀር treated as feminine. መንበረ ጴጥሮስ 'throne of Peter' (construct) is the see of Rome; -ኒ 'too'. አልቦ ዘይነብር ዲቤሃ 'there is no one who sits on her', and the apposition እለ ወለጡ ሃይማኖትነ ('those who changed our faith') says who is excluded. For ዲቤሃ, ዲብ + -ሃ 'upon her'. The Roman see will lose its legitimacy for the heretical, with the 'curb' gone.

sentences.t: እስመ ፡ ይትዐረቅ ፡ አማዑቲሆሙ ፡ ለሊቃነ ፡ ጳጳሳቲሆሙ ፡ ለእመ ፡ ነበሩ ፡ በሕሡም ፡ ሃይማኖት ፡ ዲቤሃ ፤
sentences.l: for it-will-be-emptied(?) bowels-their, of chiefs-of bishops-their, if they-sat in corrupt faith upon-her;
sentences.i: for the bowels of their chief bishops will be poured out (?) if they have sat upon it in a corrupt faith;
sentences.n: Crux, with two uncertain words (?). አማዑት I take as 'bowels, entrails', and ይትዐረቅ as 'will be emptied, poured out', so the penalty recalls the death of Judas (Acts 1:18) and of Arius, whose bowels were said to burst; but I could not check either word in Dillmann, and 'be reconciled' would be an alternative for ተዐረቀ (?). ለሊቃነ ጳጳሳቲሆሙ 'of their chief bishops' (ለ- as a genitive link after a noun with a suffix). ለእመ ነበሩ 'if they sat/dwelt'; በሕሡም ሃይማኖት 'in a corrupt (?) faith' (ሕሡም 'abominable, corrupt', not checked), ዲቤሃ 'upon it', the throne.

sentences.t: እስመ ፡ ይትኤዝዝ ፡ መልአከ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ ዘየዐቅባ ፡ ለመንበረ ፡ ጴጥሮስ ፡ በሮሜ ፡ ወመግረሬ ፡ ፀርኒ ፡ የሀይዳ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ እምኔሁ ፡ ለንጉሥ ፡ ዘኢየዐቅብ ፡ ሃይማኖተ ፡ ይፀብእዎ ፡ ፋርስ ፡ ወስሙ ፡ ይመስለኒ ፡ መርቅያኖስ ፡ ዕልወ ፡ ሃይማኖት ፤
sentences.l: for he-will-be-commanded angel-of God who guards throne-of Peter in-Rome, and-restrainer-of enemy-also he-will-remove God from-him, from-the-king who not-keeps faith; they-will-fight-him Persians, and-name-his it-seems-to-me Marcian, perverter-of faith;
sentences.i: for the angel of God who guards the throne of Peter in Rome will be given his orders, and God will remove the curb for the enemy from him, from the king who does not keep the faith; the Persians will fight him, and his name, it seems to me, is Marcian, a perverter of the faith;
sentences.n: ይትኤዝዝ is the tä- stem of አዘዘ 'command', 'will be commanded'; what the angel is told is not stated (to withdraw?). ዘየዐቅባ 'who guards her' (ዐቀበ 'keep, guard'). የሀይዳ 'he will remove' (ሀየደ). ዘኢየዐቅብ 'who does not keep'. ይፀብእዎ 'they will fight him' (ፀብአ). The king is called መርቅያኖስ with the author's own hedge ይመስለኒ 'it seems to me' (the author speaks in the first person). Marcian, the emperor of the council of Chalcedon (450-457), is the likeliest reference, but history does not fit the Persian war that follows; I keep the name as printed. ዕልወ is read as 'perverter' or 'perverse (in)' (ዕልው), a construct before ሃይማኖት (?).

sentences.t: ወይከብቶ ፡ ንጉሠ ፡ ፋርስ ፡ ዘስሙ ፡ ሃሬኔዎስ ፡ ወይነሥኦ ፡ ምስለ ፡ ፈረሱ ፡ ንጉሥ ፤
sentences.l: and-he-will-surround-him king-of Persia whose-name Harenaeus, and-he-will-take-him with horse-his, the-king;
sentences.i: and the king of Persia, whose name is Harenaeus, will surround him and will take him, the king, with his horse;
sentences.n: ሃሬኔዎስ, the name of the Persian king, is as printed and I cannot identify him; it may be a corruption of a Greek or Persian name (?) and is kept. ይከብቶ I read as ይከብቦ 'he will surround him' (ከበበ), with ቶ for ቦ (?), a slip of the digitization or the manuscript. ወይነሥኦ ... ንጉሥ 'will take him ... the king', the last word in apposition to the -ኦ 'him'.

sentences.t: ወበፈቃደ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ ይትሀወክ ፡ ፈረስ ፡ ዘቦቱ ፡ መግረሬ ፡ ፀር ፡ ወይበውእ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ባሕር ፡ ወየኀልቅ ፡ በህየ ፤
sentences.l: and-by-will-of God it-will-be-shaken horse which-in-him restrainer-of enemy, and-it-will-enter into sea, and-it-will-perish there;
sentences.i: and by the will of God the horse that has the curb for the enemy will be thrown into confusion, and will enter the sea and perish there;
sentences.n: ይትሀወክ 'will be shaken, troubled' (tä- stem of ሀወከ). ዘቦቱ 'which has in it', 'that has' (the bit is fastened on the horse). The horse's panic carries both king and curb into the sea. ወየኀልቅ 'and will perish' (ኀልቀ 'end, perish').

sentences.t: ወቅንዋትሰ ፡ ታበርህ ፡ ህየ ፡ በውስተ ፡ ባሕር ፡ እስከ ፡ ይመጽእ ፡ ክርስቶስ ፡ ዳግመ ፡ በዐቢይ ፡ ስብሐት ፡ በደመና ፡ ሰማይ ፡ ምስለ ፡ ኀይል ፡ ዘንተኬ ፡ አርአየኒ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ በውስተ ፡ ግብ ፤
sentences.l: and-the-nails-as-for she-will-shine there in-midst-of sea until he-comes Christ again with-great glory on-cloud-of heaven with power; this-indeed he-showed-me God in-midst-of pit;
sentences.i: As for the nails, they will shine there in the sea until Christ comes again in great glory on the cloud of heaven with power. This God showed me in the pit;
sentences.n: ቅንዋት 'nails', and ታበርህ 'she shines' (3rd feminine singular imperfect of አብርሀ, causative of በርሀ 'be bright'): the plural is treated as a collective feminine. The Second Coming is in the words of Matthew 24:30 (the Son of man coming on the clouds of heaven with power and great glory); ዳግመ 'again' is the accusative adverb. ዘንተኬ 'this indeed' is the object of አርአየኒ 'he showed me' (አርአየ, causative of ርእየ, with -ኒ). በውስተ ግብ 'in the pit': the author gives Gregory a vision in a pit, in the manner of Gregory the Illuminator of Armenia, who was imprisoned in one, though the text says only 'Gregory'. The seer is the speaker.

sentences.t: ወበእንተ ፡ ንጉሠ ፡ ኢትዮጵያ ፡ ወጽዮን ፡ መርዓተ ፡ ሰማይ ፡ ወሰረገላ ፡ በዘ ፡ ይረውጹ ፡ አነ ፡ እነግረክሙ ፡ ዘከሠተ ፡ ሊተ ፡ አምላኪየ ፡ ወአለበወኒ ፤
sentences.l: and-concerning king-of Ethiopia and-Zion bride-of heaven, and-chariot in-which they-run, I I-will-tell-you what-he-revealed to-me my-God and-gave-understanding-me;
sentences.i: And concerning the king of Ethiopia and Zion, the bride of heaven, and the chariot on which they run, I will tell you what my God has revealed to me and made me understand;
sentences.n: ወበእንተ 'and concerning' opens the second topic after the bridle. መርዓተ ሰማይ 'bride of heaven', Zion as the heavenly bride (the New Jerusalem as a bride in Revelation 21:2 is the likely image). በዘ ይረውጹ 'in which they run': ዘ- 'that' with በ- 'in, on' and ሮጸ 'run' (3rd plural imperfect), the 'they' being the king and his people. እነግረክሙ 'I will tell you'; ዘከሠተ ሊተ 'what he revealed to me'; ወአለበወኒ 'and he gave me understanding' (the same verb as in unit 1).

sentences.t: ትነብር ፡ በርትዕት ፡ ሃይማኖት ፡ እስከ ፡ ምጽአተ ፡ እግዚእነ ፡ ወአልቦ ፡ ዘትጸንን ፡ እምቃለ ፡ ሐዋርያት ፡ ወንሕነ ፡ በከመ ፡ ሠራዕነ ፡ ትሄሉ ፡ እስከ ፡ ኅልቀተ ፡ ዓለም ፨
sentences.l: She-will-dwell in-right faith until coming-of Lord-our, and-there-is-not what she-holds-firm(?) beyond word-of apostles, and-we as we-ordained she-will-be until end-of world.
sentences.i: She will abide in the right faith until the coming of our Lord, and there is nothing she holds fast to (?) beyond the word of the apostles; and we, as we have ordained, she will remain until the end of the world.
sentences.n: The subject ትነብር 'she will dwell' is feminine and unnamed, probably Ethiopia, the land of the king and Zion (?). ትጸንን is the problem: if from ጸንዐ 'be firm', the final -ን is a slip, and I give 'holds fast'; the sense might be 'strays' (?). እምቃለ 'beyond, apart from the word of' (እም- comparative). ወንሕነ በከመ ሠራዕነ 'and we, as we have ordained' resumes unit 5. እስከ ኅልቀተ ዓለም 'until the end of the world' (Matthew 28:20). The single ፨ here ends a stretch of Gregory's speech and the unit; the run of ፨ comes at the end of the chapter.

sentences.t: ወአውሥእዎ ፡ ለገባሬ ፡ መንክር ፡ ወይቤልዎ ፡ አመኬ ፡ ይመጽእ ፡ ሰማልያል ፡ ይትኀበልኑ ፡ ውሕኮ ፡ ሃይማኖቶሙ ፡ ለኢትዮጵያ ፡ ዘውእቱ ፡ ሐሳዌ ፡ መሲሕ ፡ አውሥአ ፡ ወይቤ ፡ አልቦ ፡ አኮኑ ፡ ተነበየ ፡ ዳዊት ፡ ወይቤ ፡ ኢትዮጵያ ፡ ታበጽሕ ፡ እደዊሃ ፡ ኀበ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፤
sentences.l: And-they-answered-him to-worker-of wonder and-they-said-to-him: When then he-comes Samalyal will-it-be-harmed-? diminution(?) faith-their of-Ethiopia, who he false messiah? He-answered and-he-said: No. Is-it-not-so he-prophesied David and-he-said: Ethiopia she-will-stretch-out hands-her to God;
sentences.i: And they answered the worker of wonders and said to him, 'And when Samalyal comes, who is the false Messiah, will the faith of Ethiopia be harmed, or weakened (?)?' He answered and said, 'No. Did not David prophesy and say, Ethiopia will stretch out her hands to God?'
sentences.n: Antichrist asked about. ሰማልያል (printed so) is the name given to the false Messiah ('Antichrist'); the form looks like Samael with -yal (?), an unknown to me. ዘውእቱ ሐሳዌ መሲሕ 'who is the false messiah' (ሐሳዌ 'liar, false'). አመኬ 'when then'. ይትኀበልኑ 'will it be harmed' (ተኀበለ 'be injured, damaged'; -ኑ marks the question). ውሕኮ is a crux: read as 'weakening, being few' (ውሕክ 'few') (?), so 'be harmed, diminished' (?). ሃይማኖቶሙ ለኢትዮጵያ 'their faith, of Ethiopia' (collective 'their' for the country). The answer is አልቦ 'no'. David's saying is Psalm 68:31 (67:32 in the Greek numbering): 'Ethiopia shall stretch out her hands to God'. ታበጽሕ 'she will stretch out' (causative of በጽሐ 'arrive', 'make reach'). The book goes through Ethiopia's hope in these words.

sentences.t: ወዘንተ ፡ ዘይቤ ፡ ኢየዐልዉ ፡ ወኢይዌልጡ ፡ ዘንተ ፡ ሃይማኖትነ ፡ ወሥርዐትነ ፡ ወዘእለ ፡ እምቅድሜነ ፡ መምህራነ ፡ ሕግ ፡ ሐዋርያት ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨
sentences.l: And-this which he-said, they-will-not-pervert and-not-change this faith-our and-ordinance-our and-that-of those from-before-us teachers-of law, apostles.
sentences.i: And this that he said means they will neither pervert nor change this our faith and our ordinance, and that of those before us, the teachers of the law, the apostles.
sentences.n: Gregory's closing comment on the psalm. ዘንተ ዘይቤ 'this which he said' stands before the main clause as a topic (David's words); ኢየዐልዉ 'they will not pervert' and ኢይዌልጡ 'they will not change' are 3rd plural, the subject the people of Ethiopia and their enemies, left open. ወሥርዐትነ 'and our ordinance' (ሥርዓት). ወዘእለ እምቅድሜነ 'and that of those before us', then the apposition መምህራነ ሕግ ሐዋርያት 'teachers of the law, the apostles'. The string of ፨ closes chapter 113; kept attached to this unit.

sentences.t: ፻፲፬ ፡ በእንተ ፡ ግብአታ ፡ ለጽዮን ።
sentences.l: 114. Concerning her-return of-Zion.
sentences.i: Chapter 114: Concerning the return of Zion
sentences.n: Chapter heading. ፻፲፬ is 114. ግብአታ is ግብአት 'return, entry' (from ገብአ 'return, enter') + -ሃ 'her' with ለጽዮን 'of Zion' (the possessive link: 'her return, of Zion'). 'Return' is my choice for the Ark's coming at the end; 'entrance' is possible (?).

sentences.t: ወታቦተ ፡ ሕጉኒ ፡ ለእግዚኣብሔር ፡ ጽዮን ፡ ቅድስት ፡ ትነብር ፡ ህየ ፡ እስከ ፡ ውእተ ፡ አሚረ ፡ አመ ፡ ይነብር ፡ እግዚእነ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ደብረ ፡ ጽዮን ፤
sentences.l: And-ark-of law-his-also of-God, Zion holy, she-will-dwell there until that day when he-sits Lord-our on mount-of Zion;
sentences.i: And the Ark of his law too, the holy Zion of God, will stay there until that day when our Lord sits on Mount Zion;
sentences.n: ታቦት 'ark' (ታቦተ, construct) with ሕጉ 'his law' and -ኒ 'too', then ለእግዚኣብሔር, so 'the ark of his law, that of God'; ጽዮን ቅድስት 'holy Zion' is in apposition: Zion is the Ark. The 'there' (ህየ) is the place the Ark now is, named in the earlier chapters (Ethiopia). ይነብር እግዚእነ ውስተ ደብረ ጽዮን 'our Lord sits on Mount Zion': ነበረ is 'sit, dwell'; the Lord's session at the end is the picture of Revelation 14:1 and Joel 3:17 (?).

sentences.t: ወትመጽእ ፡ ጽዮን ፡ ወታስተርኢ ፡ ለኵሉ ፡ ድሉተ ፡ ወሕንጽታ ፡ በከመ ፡ ቀፈላ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ በ፫ ፡ ማኅተም ፤
sentences.l: And-she-will-come Zion and-she-will-appear to-all prepared, and-building-her, as he-fastened-her Moses with three seal;
sentences.i: And Zion will come and appear to everyone, made ready, with her whole structure, as Moses had shut her up with three seals;
sentences.n: ወታስተርኢ 'and she will appear' (አስተርአየ). ድሉተ 'ready' (accusative predicate, fem.). ወሕንጽታ 'and her building' (ሕንጸት 'structure' + -ሃ (?)); I take it as her construction, the Ark's make. ቀፈላ 'he shut her' (ቀፈለ 'close, fasten'; Dillmann not at hand (?)), with -ላ 'her' (the Ark). በ፫ ማኅተም 'with three seals': the three seals are not identified in the text.

sentences.t: በከመ ፡ ይቤ ፡ በሕግ ፡ ዘብሉይ ፡ ወዘሐዲስ ፡ በስምዐ ፡ ፪ ፡ ወ፫ ፡ ይቁም ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ነገር ፡ ወአሜሃ ፡ ይቤ ፡ ኢሳይያስ ፡ ነቢይ ፡ ምዉታን ፡ ይትነሥኡ ፡ ወየሐይዉ ፡ እለ ፡ ውስተ ፡ መቃብር ፡ እስመ ፡ ጠል ፡ ዘእምኀቤከ ፡ ሕይወቶሙ ፡ ውእቱ ፤
sentences.l: As he-said in-law, which-of old and-which-of new: by-testimony-of 2 and 3 let-stand every matter; and-then he-said Isaiah prophet: The-dead they-will-rise and-they-will-live those in tomb, for dew which-from-you life-their it;
sentences.i: As it says in the law, old and new, 'By the testimony of two or three let every matter stand.' And then Isaiah the prophet said, 'The dead will rise and live, those in the grave, for the dew that comes from you is their life.'
sentences.n: Two quotations. First, the rule of witnesses, Deuteronomy 19:15, repeated in Matthew 18:16 and 2 Corinthians 13:1; ዘብሉይ ወዘሐዲስ 'of the old and of the new' means both testaments. The text has ፪ ወ፫ 'two and three'; ይቁም is the jussive of ቆመ. Second, Isaiah 26:19. ጠል 'dew' as the life-giving dew of the resurrection; ዘእምኀቤከ 'which is from you' (God). The dew of mercy returns in the next unit. ወአሜሃ 'and then' marks the second proof.

sentences.t: ወሶበ ፡ ተንሥኡ ፡ ምዉታን ፡ በጠለ ፡ ምሕረቱ ፡ ዘይሰቅያ ፡ ለምድር ፡ ይቀውሙ ፡ ቅድሜሁ ፡ ምስለ ፡ ምግባራቲሆሙ ፡ ዘገብሩ ፤
sentences.l: And-when they-rose the-dead by-dew-of mercy-his which-waters the-earth, they-will-stand before-him with deeds-their that they-did;
sentences.i: And when the dead have risen by the dew of his mercy, which waters the earth, they will stand before him with the deeds that they did;
sentences.n: ጠለ ምሕረቱ 'dew of his mercy' (construct, ሁ 'his'), the Isaiah image. ዘይሰቅያ 'which waters her' (ሰቀየ 'give to drink'), doubled by ለምድር; the relative ዘ- could go with ጠል 'dew' or with ምሕረቱ; both give the same sense. ምስለ ምግባራቲሆሙ ዘገበሩ 'with their deeds which they made': the judgment scene of Revelation 20:12-13.

sentences.t: ወይመጽኡ ፡ ሄኖክ ፡ ወኤልያስ ፡ እንዘ ፡ ሕያዋን ፡ ከመ ፡ ይኩኑ ፡ ለስምዕ ፡ ወሙሴ ፡ ወአሮን ፡ እምነ ፡ ምዉታን ፡ ሐይዉ ፡ ምስለ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ወይፈትሑ ፡ መዛግሒሃ ፡ ወያርእይዎሙ ፡ ለአይሁድ ፡ ሰቃልያን ፡ ወይወቅሥዎሙ ፡ ወይዛለፍዎሙ ፡ በእንተ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ዘዐለዉ ፡ ቃለ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፤
sentences.l: And-they-will-come Enoch and-Elijah while living, that they-be for-witness, and-Moses and-Aaron from-the-dead they-lived with all, and-they-will-open bolts-her(?) and-they-will-show-them to-Jews crucifiers, and-they-will-rebuke-them and-they-will-reproach-them on-account-of all that they-perverted word-of God;
sentences.i: And Enoch and Elijah will come alive to be witnesses, and Moses and Aaron, who have come to life from the dead, with them all; and they will open her bolts (?) and show the Jews, the crucifiers, and will rebuke and reproach them for all that they perverted of the word of God;
sentences.n: The four who testify: Enoch and Elijah, who never died (Genesis 5:24, 2 Kings 2:11), come እንዘ ሕያዋን 'while living'; Moses and Aaron, who did, are raised (ሐይዉ 'they lived', perfect). ምስለ ኵሉ 'with all' = with everyone else. መዛግሒሃ 'her bolts' (?): I take the word from a root 'shut', 'fasten' (ዘገሐ) (?), since the Ark is opened and its contents are shown in the next unit; 'her treasuries' (መዛግብት) would be a stretch. ይፈትሑ 'they will open, loosen' (ፈትሐ). ወያርእይዎሙ 'and they will show them' (አርአየ), ለአይሁድ ሰቃልያን 'to the Jews, crucifiers' (ሰቃልያን, plural of an agent noun from ሰቀለ). ወይወቅሥዎሙ ወይዛለፍዎሙ 'they will rebuke them and reproach them' (ወቀሠ, ዛለፈ). ዘዐለዉ ቃለ እግዚኣብሔር 'what they perverted, the word of God' (ዐለወ, as unit 8).

sentences.t: ወይሬእዩ ፡ ዘጸሐፈ ፡ ሎሙ ፡ በእዴሁ ፡ ቃላተ ፡ ለትእዛዙ ፡ ወመና ፡ ዘከመ ፡ ሴሰዮሙ ፡ ዘእንበለ ፡ ጻማ ፡ ምስለ ፡ መስፈሩ ፡ ጎሞር ፡ ወመንፈሳዊት ፡ ጽዮን ፡ ለመድኀኒቶሙ ፡ ዘወረደት ፡ ወበትረ ፡ አሮንመ ፡ እንተ ፡ ሠረጸት ፡ በአምሳለ ፡ ማርያም ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨
sentences.l: And-they-will-see what he-wrote to-them by-hand-his, words-of command-his, and-manna how he-fed-them without toil, with measure-its gomor, and-spiritual Zion for-salvation-their that-descended, and-rod-of Aaron-indeed which she-sprouted in-likeness-of Mary.
sentences.i: And they will see what he wrote for them with his own hand, the words of his commandment; and the manna, how he fed them without toil, with its measure, the gomor; and spiritual Zion, who came down for their salvation; and the rod of Aaron, which budded, in the likeness of Mary.
sentences.n: What the opened Ark holds, as in Hebrews 9:4: the tablets (Exodus 31:18, 'written with the finger of God'; here 'by his hand'), the manna with its omer (Exodus 16:32-33), and Aaron's rod that budded (Numbers 17:8). ቃላተ ለትእዛዙ 'words of his commandment', i.e. the Ten Words. ሴሰዮሙ 'he fed them' (ሴሰየ); ዘእንበለ ጻማ 'without toil'. ጎሞር is a loan from Hebrew omer, a measure. መንፈሳዊት ጽዮን 'spiritual Zion', ዘወረደት 'who came down' (ወረደ), for their salvation (ለመድኀኒቶሙ), joins the Ark with the heavenly Zion. ወበትረ አሮንመ 'and the rod of Aaron, indeed' (-መ is a particle like -ሰ here). ሠረጸት 'she sprouted'. The rod is read as a type of Mary, as with Jacob's staff in chapter 112. The ፨ run closes chapter 114.

sentences.t: ፻፲፭ ፡ በእንተ ፡ ቅስተ ፡ እስራኤል ።
sentences.l: 115. Concerning chastisement(?)-of Israel.
sentences.i: Chapter 115: Concerning the chastisement of Israel (?)
sentences.n: Chapter heading. ፻፲፭ is 115. ቅስተ is a crux (?): the form looks like ቅስት, in the construct, and I take it as 'chastisement, scourge' from the contents of the chapter, where Israel is blamed and judged. The other possibility is 'bow' (ቀስት), which does not fit. Dillmann was not open (?).

sentences.t: ወያወሥኦሙ ፡ ወይብሎሙ ፡ ለምንት ፡ ክሕድክሙኒ ፡ ወዐለውክሙኒ ፡ ወሰቀልክሙኒ ፡ ዘንተ ፡ ኵሎ ፡ ዘገበርኩ ፡ ለክሙ ፡ ወአድኀንኩክሙ ፡ ወሪድየ ፡ እምሰይጣን ፡ ወእምግብርናተ ፡ ፈርዖን ፡ ወበእንቲአክሙኒ ፡ መጻእኩ ፡ ወአንትሙሰ ፡ ርእዩ ፡ ዘከመ ፡ ቀነውክሙኒ ፡ ወረገዝክሙኒ ፡ ወይትነሥኡ ፡ ወይኴንንዎሙ ፡ ፲ወ፪ ፡ ሐዋርያት ፡ እንዘ ፡ ይብልዎሙ ፡ አስማዕናክሙ ፡ ወኢሰማዕክሙ ፡ ትንቢተ ፡ ነቢያት ፡ ወስብከተነ ፡ ለነ ፡ ለሐዋርያት ።
sentences.l: And-he-will-answer-them and-he-will-say-to-them: Why did-you-deny-me and-did-perversely-to-me and-did-you-hang-me, this all that I-did for-you, and-I-saved-you and-my-help(?) from-Satan and-from-bondage-of Pharaoh, and-on-account-of-you-also I-came; and-you-as-for see how you-nailed-me and-you-pierced-me; and-they-will-rise and-they-will-judge-them 12 apostles while they-say-to-them: We-made-you-hear and-you-did-not-hear prophecy-of prophets and-preaching-our, of-us of-apostles.
sentences.i: And he will answer them and say to them, 'Why did you deny me, and turn perversely against me, and crucify me, after all this that I did for you? I saved you and helped you (?) from Satan and from the bondage of Pharaoh, and I came for your sake. And you, see how you nailed me and pierced me.' And the twelve apostles will rise and judge them, saying to them, 'We made you hear, and you did not hear, the prophecy of the prophets and our preaching, we the apostles.'
sentences.n: Christ speaks to the Jews at the last day. ወያወሥኦሙ 'and he will answer them', the verb in the imperfect. ክሕድክሙኒ 'you denied me' (ክሕደ), ወዐለውክሙኒ 'you acted perversely to me' (ዐለወ, here with a person as object (?)), ወሰቀልክሙኒ 'you hung me' = crucified, each with -ኒ 'me'. ዘንተ ኵሎ ዘገበርኩ ለክሙ 'this all, which I did for you', set before the verbs as a reproach. ወሪድየ is a crux (?): I take it as ረድአ 'help' with the verb form unclear, giving 'and helped you'; the sentence also uses እም- 'from Satan', then 'from the bondage of Pharaoh' (ግብርና 'bondage', ወእምግብርናተ). ወበእንቲአክሙኒ 'and for your sake'. ርእዩ 'see!' (imperative). ቀነውክሙኒ 'you nailed me' (house: nail), ወረገዝክሙኒ 'you pierced me' (?), as in John 19:34. ፲ወ፪ ሐዋርያት 'the twelve apostles' will judge (Matthew 19:28; Luke 22:30). አስማዕናክሙ 'we made you hear' (causative of ሰምዐ). ለነ ለሐዋርያት 'ours, of the apostles', the repeated appositive.

sentences.t: ወይበክዩ ፡ ወይኔስሑ ፡ በኀበ ፡ ኢይበቊዕ ፡ ወየሐውሩ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ኵነኔ ፡ ዘለዓለም ፤
sentences.l: And-they-will-weep and-they-will-repent where not-it-avails, and-they-will-go into judgment of-eternity;
sentences.i: And they will weep and repent where it does not avail, and will go into everlasting judgment;
sentences.n: ይበክዩ (በከየ 'weep'), ይኔስሑ (ነስሐ 'repent'), በኀበ ኢይበቊዕ 'where it avails not' (በቊዐ 'profit, avail'), echoing Hebrews 12:17. ወየሐውሩ 'and they will go'. ኵነኔ ዘለዓለም 'judgment of eternity' = everlasting judgment (compare Matthew 25:46; Mark 3:29). The 'they' remains the Jews of the preceding scene.

sentences.t: ምስለ ፡ ዲያብሎስ ፡ አቡሆሙ ፡ ዘአመከሮሙ ፡ ወአጋንንቲሁ ፡ መስሕታን ፡ ይትኀተሙ ፡ ረሲዓን ።
sentences.l: with devil father-their who-tempted-them and-demons-his deceivers they-will-be-sealed wicked.
sentences.i: together with the Devil, their father, who tempted them, and his demons, the deceivers, the wicked will be sealed up.
sentences.n: The Devil is 'their father' as in John 8:44. ዘአመከሮሙ 'who tempted them' (አመከረ, as ያሜክርዎ in unit 31). መስሕታን 'deceivers' (plural of መስሕት), in apposition to demons. ይትኀተሙ 'they will be sealed (up)' (ተኀተመ, tä- stem of ኀተመ 'seal'), with ረሲዓን 'the wicked' (ረሲዕ) as subject, as in Revelation 20:3. The English word order follows the Geʿez, with ምስለ at the start picking up the ending of the last unit.

sentences.t: ወእለሰ ፡ አምኑ ፡ ወተጠምቁ ፡ ቦቱ ፡ በቅድስት ፡ ሥላሴ ፡ ወተመጠዉ ፡ ሥጋሁ ፡ ወደሞ ፡ ይከውኑ ፡ ሎቱ ፡ አግብርተ ፡ በኵሉ ፡ ልቦሙ ፡ እስመ ፡ አልቦ ፡ ዘይክል ፡ ጸሊአ ፡ ሥጋሁ ፡ ግሙራ ፡ ይጸርኅ ፡ ሥጋ ፡ ክርስቶስ ፡ በውስተ ፡ ሥጋነ ፡ ወይምሕር ፡ በእንተ ፡ ሥጋሁ ፡ ወደሙ ፡ እስመ ፡ ኮንዎ ፡ ውሉዲ ፡ ወአኀዊሁ ፤
sentences.l: And-those-indeed they-believed and-were-baptized in-him, in-holy Trinity, and-they-partook-of body-his and-blood-his, they-will-be to-him servants with-all heart-their, for there-is-not who is-able to-hate flesh-his wholly(?); she-cries flesh-of Christ in-flesh-our, and-he-has-mercy for-sake-of body-his and-blood-his, for they-became-to-him sons-his and-brothers-his;
sentences.i: But those who believed and were baptized in him, in the holy Trinity, and partook of his body and his blood, will be servants to him with all their heart, for no one is able to hate his own flesh at all (?); the flesh of Christ cries out within our flesh, and he has mercy for the sake of his body and blood, for they have become his sons and his brothers;
sentences.n: The faithful, set against the Jews. ወእለሰ 'but those who' (-ሰ contrast). ተጠምቁ 'were baptized', ተመጠዉ 'partook' (ተመጠወ 'take communion'), with ሥጋሁ ወደሞ 'his body and his blood' (ደሞ is ደሙ with a variant ending). ዘይክል ጸሊአ 'who is able to hate'; ሥጋሁ 'his flesh', after Ephesians 5:29, 'no one ever hated his own flesh'. ግሙራ 'wholly' is placed between two clauses and could go with either (?): I take it with the first. ይጸርኅ ሥጋ ክርስቶስ በውስተ ሥጋነ 'the flesh of Christ cries out in our flesh': the Eucharistic union. እስመ ኮንዎ ውሉዲ ወአኀዊሁ 'for they became to him sons and brothers': ውሉዲ is ውሉዱ 'his sons' with -ዲ for -ዱ as in chapter 112 (ወልዲ, ዘመዲ); see Hebrews 2:11, 'not ashamed to call them brothers'.

sentences.t: ወእመኒቦ ፡ ዘአበሱ ፡ ይትኴነኑ ፡ መጠነ ፡ አበሳሆሙ ፡ በእሳት ፡ ለዘ ፡ ቀሊል ፡ ጾሩ ፡ ቀሊል ፡ ኵነኔሁ ፡ ወለዘ ፡ ክቡድ ፡ ጾሩ ፡ ፈድፈደ ፡ ኵነኔሁ ፤
sentences.l: And-if-there-is who they-sinned they-will-be-judged measure-of sins-their in-fire; to-him-who light burden-his light judgment-his, and-to-him-who heavy burden-his it-is-multiplied judgment-his;
sentences.i: And if there are any who sinned, they will be judged in fire according to the measure of their sins: for him whose burden is light, his judgment is light, and for him whose burden is heavy, his judgment is greater;
sentences.n: A graduated judgment, after Luke 12:47-48 (the servant who knew and the one who did not know are beaten with many or with few stripes: 'to whom much is given, much will be required'). ወእመኒቦ 'and if there be anyone'; ዘአበሱ 'who sinned'; መጠነ አበሳሆሙ 'to the measure of their sins' (መጠነ as a preposition); በእሳት 'in fire'. ጾር 'burden, load' (here the weight of sin) with -ሁ gives ጾሩ. ፈድፈደ 'exceeds, is multiplied'; ክቡድ 'heavy'. The fire is the fire of judgment, graded by the load of sin.

sentences.t: አሐቲ ፡ ዕለት ፡ በኀበ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ መጠነ ፡ ፼ ፡ ዓመት ፡ ቦዘ ፡ ይትኴነን ፡ መጠነ ፡ ዕለት ፡ ወቦመንፈቀ ፡ ዕለት ፡ ወቦ ፡ ፫ ፡ ሰዐት ፡ ዘዕለት ፡ ወቦ ፡ ፩ ፡ ሰዓት ፡ ዘዕለት ፡ ወቦዘያሜክርዎ ፡ ወያስተናጽሕዎ ፡ እምነ ፡ አበሳሁ ፨ ፨ ፨
sentences.l: One day with God measure-of 10,000 year; there-is-who he-is-judged measure-of day, and-there-is half-of day, and-there-is 3 hours of-day, and-there-is 1 hour of-day, and-there-is-who they-test-him and-they-cleanse-him from sin-his.
sentences.i: One day with God is as ten thousand years (?). Some are judged for the measure of a day, and some for half a day, and some for three hours of the day, and some for one hour of the day; and some they test and cleanse from their sin.
sentences.n: The measure after 2 Peter 3:8 and Psalm 90:4 (one day with the Lord as a thousand years). The text has ፼ ዓመት, with ፼ the sign for 10,000, not ፲፻ 'a thousand'; I keep it as printed and give 'ten thousand' (?), a probable slip for 1,000 or a deliberate enlargement. ቦዘ is ቦ ዘ run together, 'there is one who', and ወቦዘያሜክርዎ is ወቦ ዘ ያሜክርዎ, 'and there is one whom they test' (አመከረ, with the long vowel as in ይዌልጥዋ): printed without spaces, kept. In ወቦመንፈቀ ዕለት and ወቦ ፫ ሰዐት the verb 'is judged' is understood from the first; ሰዐት and ሰዓት are two spellings in the same unit. ያስተናጽሕዎ 'they cleanse him' (አስተናጽሐ). The 'they' who test and cleanse are not named. The last ፨ ፨ ፨ closes the part.
